sentence: If we spend hours telling each other our deepest longings and fears, than I’ll naturally be ready to help when you need me.

If you want something closer to “casual love-making” without quiet so many ways to damage each other, you probably need to find a free-love community where the people aren’t disposable, the bonds can be acknowledged, and any children have a village.
So I ask, “Do you want me to help figure this out, or do you mostly want me to glisten?
